BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

2. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.

3. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

7. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

12. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

13. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.

14. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

16. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Building Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
